description_en: Verifies the authenticity and consistency of a name and ID card number against an authoritative data source

kebab_example: aliyun cloudauth id-2-meta-verify --param-type normal --identify-num '明文：429001000000008211_密文：_42900132fa7bcd874161bea8ec8fd98f390ec98211' --user-name '明文：张三_密文：_6499fc7409049355527ef6a2ba5706b8三​' --api-version 2019-03-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: Id2MetaVerify

parameters.help_en:
The encryption method. Valid values:

normal: plaintext without encryption

md5: MD5 encryption
parameters.help_zh:
加密方式：

normal：明文不加密

md5：MD5加密
parameters.name: param_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID card number.

Note
Only second-generation resident ID card numbers and Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan residence permit numbers are supported.

If ParamType is set to normal, enter the ID card number in plaintext.

If ParamType is set to md5, the format is: first 6 digits of the ID card number (plaintext) + date of birth (ciphertext) + last 4 digits of the ID card number (plaintext)
parameters.help_zh:
身份证号：

说明
仅支持二代居民身份证和港澳台居住证的证件号码。

paramType 传 normal 时：输入身份证号明文。

paramType 传 md5 时：身份证号前6位（明文）+出生年月日（密文）+身份证号后4位（明文）
parameters.name: identify_num

parameters.help_en:
The name.

If ParamType is set to normal, enter the name in plaintext.

If ParamType is set to md5, the format is: first character of the name (ciphertext) + remaining characters of the name (plaintext)
parameters.help_zh:
姓名：

paramType 传 normal 时：输入姓名明文。

paramType 传 md5 时：姓名第一个字密文+ 姓名其他部分明文
parameters.name: user_name

Code.description_en: The response code. 200 indicates that the request was successful
Code.description_zh: 返回码，200表示接口响应成功

BizCode.description_en:
The verification result code. Valid values:
1: Consistent.
2: Inconsistent.
3: No record found
BizCode.description_zh:
核验结果码：
1：核验一致。
2：核验不一致。
3：查无记录
